rationale: RBLX gapped down ~13% on earnings and is now trading at 6.6% of today's range, near session lows with price below VWAP ($43.29) and below the 9-EMA ($42.03), suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the last few 1-minute candles show a slight bounce attempt off the $41.36 low with a high-volume spike, creating ambiguity about direction — a failed bounce could accelerate lower while a genuine reversal could squeeze shorts. With SPY down 2.37% and VIXY up 17%, broad market risk is elevated, making a long risky; but with only 85 minutes to close and price already deeply extended from prior close, a short entry here risks a mean-reversion snap. The risk/reward in either direction lacks sufficient clarity to justify a position.
